test_title: PYST 7: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 11 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In 2013, Ikea received government approval for its ₹10,500 crore FDI proposal to set up 10 stores with connected infrastructure over 10 years. This is a ______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Swedish company**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ikea** is a multinational company that originated from **Sweden**. It was founded in **1943** by **Ingvar Kamprad** in the town of **Älmhult**, Sweden.
 
• The company is well-known for its **ready-to-assemble furniture**, home appliances, and other household goods.
 
• In **2013**, Ikea received approval from the Indian government for a **₹10,500 crore Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)** proposal to establish **10 stores** over the next 10 years. *This statement is correct.*
 
• The approval allowed Ikea to set up stores with connected infrastructure, emphasizing its commitment to the **Indian retail market**.
 
• Ikea's entry into India marked a significant step in the liberalization of the Indian retail sector, allowing 100% FDI in single-brand retail under specific guidelines. *This statement is correct.*
 
• The company's strategy focuses on providing **affordable, functional, and stylish furniture**, targeting middle-class consumers in India.
 
• Ikea's Swedish roots are reflected in its minimalist designs and commitment to sustainability. *Hence, the correct answer is Swedish company.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About Ikea:**

 
 
• Ikea operates in over **50 countries** and has more than **400 stores** globally. It is a leader in the field of **furniture retail**.
 
• The name Ikea is derived from the initials of its founder (**Ingvar Kamprad**), his family farm (**Elmtaryd**), and his hometown (**Agunnaryd**).
 
• Ikea places a strong emphasis on **environmental sustainability**, aiming to use renewable or recycled materials in its products.
 
 
 
• **FDI in India:**
 
 
• The **Indian government** allows 100% FDI in single-brand retail under certain conditions, such as sourcing a specific percentage of goods locally.
 
• Ikea’s investment is one of the largest in the Indian retail sector, symbolizing the country's growing **economic openness**.
 
• The approval of Ikea’s FDI proposal in 2013 was a significant milestone in attracting global retail giants to India.
 
 
 
• **Global Presence:**
 
 
• Ikea is present in various markets across Europe, North America, Asia, and the Middle East, demonstrating its global reach.
 
• It caters to diverse customer needs with products that are **affordable** and **environmentally friendly**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Swedish Design Philosophy:**

 
 
• Ikea’s designs are inspired by the Swedish principle of **“lagom”**, meaning “just the right amount.”
 
• Products are created to maximize functionality while minimizing environmental impact.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Indian Market:**
 
 
• Ikea’s entry into India has increased competition in the **organized retail furniture sector**.
 
• It has also contributed to **job creation** and the development of **local supply chains**.
